name: Engagement margin review
summary: Midway or at close, the partner and finance lead get one worksheet for an engagement: recorded time, agreed fee, billed to date and supplied costs by workstream, the gaps that limit it, and the questions the team must answer. No cost rate is invented.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of reviewing an engagement's economics: recorded time, agreed fee, billing and delivery costs set side by side by workstream, with every gap in the inputs shown and every decision left to the partner and the finance lead.
